consultas.descricao: Usuário de runtime da suíte sem superusuário e sem bypass de RLS
consultas.sql: select rolname, rolsuper, rolbypassrls, rolcreaterole, rolcreatedb from pg_roles where rolname = current_user

consultas.descricao: Tabelas com company_id nos schemas finance e legal sem RLS forçada (esperado: nenhuma, exceto as duas tabelas de roteamento de webhook, sem dado de tenant, documentadas)
consultas.sql: select n.nspname as schema, c.relname as tabela from pg_class c join pg_namespace n on n.oid = c.relnamespace where c.relkind = 'r' and n.nspname in ('finance','legal') and exists (select 1 from pg_attribute a where a.attrelid = c.oid and a.attname = 'company_id' and not a.attisdropped) and not (c.relrowsecurity and c.relforcerowsecurity) and c.relname not in ('bank_payment_provider_routing','signature_provider_routing') order by 1,2

consultas.descricao: Gatilhos de imutabilidade do ledger e das versões
consultas.sql: select event_object_schema as schema, event_object_table as tabela, trigger_name, event_manipulation from information_schema.triggers where event_object_schema in ('finance','legal') and (trigger_name ilike '%append%' or trigger_name ilike '%immut%' or trigger_name ilike '%guard%' or trigger_name ilike '%block%') order by 1,2,3

consultas.descricao: Trilha de auditoria append-only por gatilho (no CI o GRANT é amplo; em produção o runtime também não tem UPDATE/DELETE)
consultas.sql: select trigger_name, event_manipulation from information_schema.triggers where event_object_schema = 'audit' and event_object_table = 'audit_log' order by 1,2
select table_schema, table_name, table_type from information_schema.tables where table_schema = 'finance' and table_name = 'ledger'

consultas.descricao: Colunas de vínculo de origem/contrato/titular de caução no lançamento
consultas.sql: select column_name from information_schema.columns where table_schema = 'finance' and table_name = 'financial_entries' and column_name in ('third_party_origin_entry_id','third_party_holder_person_id','third_party_release_type','contract_id') order by 1

consultas.descricao: Nenhuma coluna monetária do schema finance é float (FIN-008)
consultas.sql: select table_name, column_name, data_type from information_schema.columns where table_schema = 'finance' and data_type in ('real','double precision') order by 1,2

consultas.descricao: Snapshot do fechamento: tabela com gatilho de imutabilidade
consultas.sql: select event_object_table as tabela, trigger_name from information_schema.triggers where event_object_schema = 'finance' and event_object_table ilike '%period%' order by 1,2

consultas.descricao: Versões de contrato: gatilho de imutabilidade
consultas.sql: select event_object_table as tabela, trigger_name from information_schema.triggers where event_object_schema = 'legal' and event_object_table in ('contract_versions','contract_clauses') order by 1,2

consultas.descricao: Contagem de empresas fictícias do seed (dois tenants) visíveis ao runtime sem contexto: zero por RLS
consultas.sql: select count(*)::int as empresas_visiveis_sem_contexto from core.companies
